title: Output Schema for Publish Message Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace publishMessage operation.

payload.description: The main response payload from the publishMessage operation.

destination.description: The name of the topic or queue the message was published to.

destinationType.description: The type of destination the message was published to (e.g., TOPIC, QUEUE).

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode used for the publish (e.g., DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT).

messageType.description: The message type used for the publish (e.g., TEXT, BYTES, XML).

ackStatus.description: The broker acknowledgement status for the publish (e.g., ACK, NACK, TIMEOUT).

ackReceived.description: Whether a broker acknowledgement was received for the published message.

correlationKey.description: The correlation key associated with the publish, or null if none was set.

error.description: Error detail when the publish was not acknowledged, or null on success.

publishedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the message was published.
